assertions.name: all history kickoffs precede main match
metadata score retained as source of truth
no season aggregate input
assertions.detail: only six match metadata, dynamic events and phases were read

notes: Metadata score is authoritative because lead_to_goal can tag a shot in a sequence differently from the official scoreboard.
Phase labels are used for historical baselines and offline evaluation; current-match online tactical inference must not read future or provider phase labels.
Three-match baselines report median/min/max and sample size. They are not a training dataset.
